title: CometChip: A High-throughput 96-Well Platform for Measuring DNA Damage in Microarrayed Human Cells
protocol: Remove chip gel from package and place into a one-well rectangular plate, gel film side down.
Wash gel in 25 ml 1x PBS for 15 min, repeat two times.
Set gel on glass plate and label orientation of gel accordingly.
Gently press an inverted bottomless 96-well plate onto the gel; ensure all wells are within the area of the gel.
Secure clamping with binder clips on each side of the plate.
Aspirate off excess PBS buffer in each well.
Prepare cell suspensions for suspension cell lines by diluting to a final concentration of 105–106 cells/ml in media.
For adherent cell lines, follow detaching/trypsinization protocols and dilute detached cells in media to a final concentration of 105–106 cells/ml.
If cells aggregate, pass cell suspension through a cell filter for a single cell suspension.
Add 100 μl of cell suspension to each well of the 96-well plate.
Cover plate with the gel film to prevent evaporation of media.
Allow cells to load for at least 30 min in a 37 °C incubator.
Remove chip from incubator and aspirate media from each well.
Remove binder clips and bottomless 96-well plate; hold the chip with the glass plate at an angle and gently rinse with 1x PBS to remove excess cells on agarose.
Check cell loading using a bright field microscope with a 4X objective lens.
Place loaded chip on an even surface.
Overlay chip with 1% low melting point (LMP) agarose pre-warmed at 37 °C.
Allow overlay to solidify first at room temperature for 3 min.
Move the overlay to a 4 °C refrigerator for 5 min to complete gelation.
Carefully align the wells of the chip with the wells of a new bottomless 96-well plate.
Re-press the bottomless 96-well plate on top and secure clamping with binder clips.
Add 100 μl of chemical of desired dose to each well of the 96-well plate.
Perform dosing/treatment on ice or in a 4 °C refrigerator for the desired amount of time.
Aspirate chemicals from each well after dosing.
Rinse away residual chemical using 1x PBS.
Allow cells in the chip to repair in media at 37 °C if studying repair kinetics.
Lysate cells at specific time points.
Make working alkaline lysis buffer by adding 1% Triton X-100 to an alkaline lysis stock solution (2.5 M NaCl, 100 mM Na2EDTA, 10 mM Tris, pH 10).
Prepare approximately 25 ml of working lysis buffer for each chip.
Chill working alkaline lysis buffer at 4°C.
Submerge chip in chilled working alkaline lysis buffer and incubate overnight at 4°C refrigerator.
Make working neutral lysis buffer by adding 1% Triton X-100 and 10% DMSO to neutral lysis stock solution (2.5 M NaCl, 100 mM Na2EDTA, 10 mM Tris, 1% N-Lauroylsarcosine, pH 9.5).
Pre-warm working neutral lysis buffer at 43°C.
Submerge chip in warmed working neutral lysis buffer and incubate overnight at 43°C incubator.
Remove lysis buffer from the chip.
Rinse chip with cold PBS for the alkaline comet assay.
Secure chip in an electrophoresis chamber, gel film side down using double-sided tape.
Fill the chamber with cold alkaline electrophoresis buffer (0.3 M NaOH, 1 mM Na2EDTA) to a level covering the gel.
Allow alkaline unwinding for 40 minutes at 4°C.
Run electrophoresis at 1 V/cm and 300 mA for 30 minutes in the cold room.
Adjust the volume of electrophoresis buffer in the chamber to achieve desired running current.
Rinse chip with neutral electrophoresis buffer (2 mM Na2EDTA, 90 mM Tris, 90 mM boric acid, pH 8.5) for two cycles of 15 minutes each at 4°C for the neutral comet assay.
Secure chip in an electrophoresis chamber, gel film side down using double-sided tape.
Bring the chamber to a 4°C cold room.
Fill the chamber with cold neutral electrophoresis buffer to a level that just covers the gel.
Allow the gel to sit in cold room for 60 min.
Run electrophoresis at 0.6 V/cm and 6 mA for 60 min in the cold room.
Adjust the volume of electrophoresis buffer in the chamber to achieve desired running current.
Remove chip from electrophoresis chamber from cold room.
Neutralize the gels in neutralization buffer for 2 x 15 min in 4 °C refrigerator.
Stain the chip with fluorescent DNA stain under factory recommended procedures.
Image using fluorescent microscopy.
Analyze comet images by standard comet assay software such as Komet 5.5.
